artboards.title: Need a day · pushed from Plan

annotations.text:
SHELL: Plan · Find · Ideas, and the bar.

Plan stays as it is. The Sort tab becomes one row at the top of Plan, “3 need a day”, that opens the Sort page (New, Snoozed, Someday; Overdue is already on Plan). Find is one field for two jobs: results as you type, and an Ask Peggy row that turns the query into a conversation. Search and Ask stop being overlays. The bar does Plan and Idea only; Ask leaves the pill. Ideas is unchanged.

Gone from the shell: the Sort tab, the Search sheet, the Ask sheet, Ask mode in the bar, the “N to sort” card (the row replaces it).
